messages:
Liam Chen: Heads up — ParcelOS invoice INV-9452 failed to collect at 03:12 UTC. Customer says they completed the 3DS step but we got a gateway error.

payments-bot: payment_failed event for customer_id=cus_74b, gateway_err=card_auth_required, code=40211, last4=4242

Jordi Patel: putting customer on hold while we retry? Do we have the retry window left on this invoice (auto-retry policy 48h)?

Maya Ortiz: We do, attempted auto-retry once (t=+2h) — next auto attempt is scheduled in ~6h. Customer is asking for immediate processing.

Liam Chen: Can we run a manual retry from the portal (with 3DS redirect) or do a server-side retry with gateway override? If we need PCI-safe flow, prefer portal.

Maya Ortiz: I'll open a support session with ParcelOS. Jordi, can you pull the gateway trace and confirm whether 3DS challenge was shown? If not, might be a gateway routing issue.

Jordi Patel: trace shows challenge_url returned but 3ds_status=failed on callback. Gateway log snippet:
```
gateway_id=pay_0x9a
callback_status=200
3ds_result=challenge_failed
auth_code=null
error=card_auth_required
```

Jordi Patel: proposing manual retry after customer completes 3DS again. I'll email a secure payment link now. @Maya please confirm before I trigger.

Maya Ortiz: Go ahead, email sent with secure link + note to complete 3DS. Also flagged for finance review if it fails again. :thumbsup: 

Ava (Legal): FYI — keep thread for audit trail in case of dispute. Include timestamps of retries and customer consent.

Liam Chen: Thanks. If manual retry fails, we'll move to wire instructions as backup (customer prefers ACH but bank on file failing). I'll update invoice and internal notes. Closing loop here — pls ping if anything changes. :pray:
